description: Work out how long a startup's cash lasts: from cash in the bank, monthly revenue and expenses, and optionally monthly revenue growth, month by month, with the break-even month if revenue catches up first. Send numbers only (percentages as 5 for 5%). Answers a headline, the figures behind it and notes. Arithmetic on your own numbers, not financial advice. Answers from what you send alone: nothing is fetched or stored.

currency.description: The sign money is written with; "none" for bare numbers. Default "$".

expenses.description: Monthly expenses. Everything that leaves the account in a month: salaries, tools, rent.

growth.description: Revenue growth per month (%). 0 if you'd rather plan on today's revenue. Optional.

name: calculate_runway
title: Calculate startup runway
